entities.name: Michael Pak Jeong-il
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michael Pak Jeong-il was a South Korean Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Jeju from 1977 to 1982, Jeonju from 1982 to 1988, and Masan from 1988 to 2002. Pak Jeong-il died on 28 August 2024, at the age of 97.
